description: IQLand turns a U.S. street address into a developer-grade property report. Resolve a parcel, read its zoning and buildable envelope, estimate construction cost, run SmartBuild feasibility against a library of architectural plans, pull comparable sales, and generate a full Appraisal IQ (cost approach + adjusted comps + reconciled value). Built for investors, developers, agents, and appraisers evaluating U.S. real estate. All tools are read-only: they look up and derive data from IQLand's zoning, cost, and architectural-plans services and public parcel/listing data, and never create, modify, or delete records.
